entities.name: Q6FTM9 KEX1
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Candida glabrata pheromone-processing carboxypeptidase KEX1; 730 aa.
KEX1 is annotated as a serine-type carboxypeptidase (EC 3.4.16.6) that preferentially removes C-terminal Lys or Arg from protein precursors.
Reference annotation places KEX1 in the Golgi/trans-Golgi network as a type I membrane protein: signal peptide 1–19, lumenal region 20–599, transmembrane helix 600–620, cytoplasmic tail 621–730.
Query Pfam scan detects Peptidase_S10 (PF00450.29), residues 48–451.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 83.3 kDa, pI 4.32, GRAVY −0.805; these do not account for processing or modifications.

Reviewed reference describes roles in pheromone precursor processing; additional cell-fusion and cell-death roles are annotated by similarity and are less directly supported than catalytic annotation.
